record_type_quote: We conduct a constructive replication of Antonakis, Fenley, and Liechti’s (2011) Study 2 using a substantially larger sample (N = 140), an upgraded measurement approach and a considerably greater number of 422 independent raters.

targets.evidence_quote: We conduct a constructive replication of Antonakis, Fenley, and Liechti’s (2011) Study 2 using a substantially larger sample (N = 140), an upgraded measurement approach and a considerably greater number of 422 independent raters.
targets.outcome_quote: Consistent with the original findings, leaders significantly increased their use of CLTs following training, and charismatic signaling generally improved follower evaluations. At the same time, linear effects were not uniformly supported across outcomes.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly reports agreement and nonuniform support for the original effects; its overall statement supports a general behavioral view rather than providing a whole-replication verdict. Reference list unavailable, so title and DOI are not supplied.
